b: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Back so soon. You must be enjoying my company, or getting nowhere. I hope it's the first.

start: ^Narrator: The Crypto Lab is quiet. Nightshade looks up from a desk with nothing on it, no photographs, no mug, and smiles as if the last nine days never happened.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': There you are. I wondered when they'd send you.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Of everyone in this building, they picked the one person who knows my tells. A compliment, or very poor planning. Ask me anything.
hub: ^Where were you when the plan leaked?
^Your insider briefing. "The calm of someone who's decided the rules don't apply."
^The root logs have your account on the Portland plan. Forty-seven minutes.
^Dr Okafor flagged you a year ago. "Ideological drift."
^The door log has you in this lab from 10:15 to 11:43 that morning.
^Your locker in the break room. I want to see inside it.

c-0: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Here, most likely. I'm always here. Pull the terminal logs. I'd genuinely encourage it.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': The truth clears people, properly examined. I've always found that a comfort.
^Narrator: He offers it without a flicker.
c-1: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Should I be? Fear is what you feel when the outcome is still uncertain. I made my peace with most outcomes long ago.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': It's a discipline. I could teach it to you, though I don't think we'll have the time.
c-2: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': I know. I do know that.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': I've been grieving a long time, 0x00. Longer than nine days. It wears smooth.
c-3: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': I did. The access a little too broad, the hours a little too odd, and the calm. Good. You were listening.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': I'd add one thing now, if I were giving that briefing again.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Don't rule anyone out because they wrote the list.
^Narrator: He holds your eye a moment longer than a colleague would.
c-4: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Then you have root on our own repository. I'm genuinely impressed. Nobody's touched that box in years.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Finish putting it through the relay. When it's all in, the Director will want this conversation in a room with a recorder.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': I'll walk down myself. I'm not going to make anyone chase me.
c-5: ^Narrator: The smile holds. Something behind it goes cold.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': You've been in the Director's safe. Good. Then you know Okafor was right, and you know he buried it.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Yes, I said those words. I say a great many true things, and nobody minds until the day they do.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Careful, 0x00. You're close to something now. Closer than is comfortable for either of us.
c-6: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Yes. I told you: I'm always here. You've proved I keep long hours, 0x00. Bring me the account.
c-7: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Take it. 0x47, second from the end. I'd genuinely encourage it.

accuse: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Do you. On instinct, or on evidence? I know you, and I know which one you're running on. It isn't evidence yet.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Here's what will happen. You'll leave, because a hunch won't hold me.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': And I'll still be here when you come back. I've nowhere I'd rather be, and nothing I'm afraid of.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Go and get your proof. I'd rather you found me than guessed me.

b: ^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Bring proof next time. It's the only thing worth bringing.
^Agent 0x47 'Nightshade': Come back when you can prove something. I'll be right here. I always am.
